notes: Exact modulo-2^32 compression for arbitrary states and blocks. Edge 1 loads the input; edges 2–65 execute 64 rounds; edge 66 registers the state addition and pulses out_valid. Supports initiation interval 66 and preserves bubbles. Uses a 16-word rolling schedule with fixed taps and one reused round datapath. Reset cancels pending work. Area and 100 MHz timing have not been measured or verified with synthesis.
